_about: Motion designers and studios whose work is the reference bar for Drip Motion. Vetted by watching their work (2026-11-26). motion_refs searches their work first. Their work belongs to them: study, never copy. 'rejected': makers watched and found below the bar; open search drops their work.

masters.name: TimeFrame
masters.style: SaaS promos where the UI is the set: panels blur, flip and morph into the next scene every 1-2 s over glowing gradient fields; continuous transformation, never a static dashboard.

masters.name: Tendril
masters.style: Cinematic CG launch films (Coinbase CB1, IBM, Qualcomm): dark macro product shots, light sweeping across surfaces, tactile materials.

masters.name: Ordinary Folk
masters.style: Fluid, elastic 2D/3D launch films (Introducing Spline); shapes morph scene to scene with confident colour and character.

masters.name: Oddfellows
masters.style: Tech-brand explainers (Adobe, Salesforce, Spotify) with seamless camera moves and objects handing off between scenes.

masters.name: Aikhan Naimanov
masters.style: Fast AI-product UI motion (Lovable): UI chips grow into the next screen, tight type swaps, hard cuts on the beat.

masters.name: ManvsMachine
masters.style: Art-directed CG with weighty, glossy materials and graphic cuts (Squarespace x Koons, Nike Air Max Day); the premium brand-film bar.

masters.name: Gunner
masters.style: Mixed 2D/3D explainers (Herman Miller): a scene reconfigures into a diagram and back; continuous camera, clear idea.

masters.name: Kris Zeljukina (Motion for SaaS)
masters.style: Clean SaaS feature films: line of type resolves into the product screen which tilts into 3D; airy light palette, one idea per beat.

masters.name: Tomas Puerta
masters.style: Google-grade SaaS motion: a glowing AI orb becomes the product input, type dissolves into UI; calm, precise, minimal.

masters.name: Not Real
masters.style: RingCentral-style isometric product UI loops: layered glass UI planes floating in 3D with soft shadow, seamless.

masters.name: Giant Ant
masters.style: Craft-heavy 2D/3D brand films with painterly colour and strong match cuts.

masters.name: Golden Wolf
masters.style: High-energy stylised 3D/2D with explosive transitions that carry one subject through changing worlds.

masters.name: Hornet
masters.style: Tactile stop-motion/puppet craft with rhythmic cuts; the bar for handmade brand film energy.

masters.name: Builders Club
masters.style: Premium product CGI (Meta AI glasses with Tendril): macro objects, warm studio light, one object morphs into the hero.

masters.name: Ina Kavaliuk
masters.style: Type as pattern: glyph fields that warp, collapse and re-form into the next word with graphic colour blocks.

masters.name: Arsenii Stepchenkov
masters.style: Dense kinetic type with mask reveals and text-stack transitions; fast and rhythmic.

masters.name: HOLOGRAPHIK
masters.style: Bold kinetic typography: words stretch, wrap and replace each other on a tight rhythm with saturated colour.

masters.name: Kickin
masters.style: Daily motion posters and kinetic type; strong graphic composition, clean loops.

masters.name: motionatwork
masters.style: Shape-continuity SaaS launch: a pill morphs into type, buttons and finally the logo; glossy soft-3D look.

masters.name: Yildiz Tokmak
masters.style: Light, glassy SaaS teaser: word swaps flow into UI sheets that fly in with perspective.

masters.name: Buck
masters.style: Top-tier design-led animation (Airbnb, Cox); crafted worlds with elegant match-cut transformations.

masters.name: Animade
masters.style: Minimal 2D craft with sharp timing and clever object transformations.

masters.name: Paper Crowns
masters.style: Hardware launch films (Herman Miller Gaming): macro machined detail, HUD type overlays, crisp transitions.

masters.name: Tomorrow Bureau
masters.style: Abstract product visualisation (Aston Martin): textures and forms slide across frame into the hero object.

masters.name: Hui Kai Su
masters.style: Light-driven reveals (MSI launch film): a sliver of light opens into saturated colour rooms; minimal and cinematic.

masters.name: Anna Schiavino
masters.style: Tech product-visualization teasers with spark, light and a hard cut to black.

masters.name: Outer Studio
masters.style: Inteller reveal: the wordmark blurs away, a dot grows into the four-petal mark which rotates and settles, then the wordmark slides back out of it; one idea, soft depth-of-field, no effects pile-up.

masters.name: Lisa Jacobs
masters.style: Monoline marks drawn on by a single travelling stroke (LJ ligature) and un-drawn on exit; stroke-follow easing, ink-like and exact, the construction of the glyph is the animation.

masters.name: Zauri Miminoshvili
masters.style: Geometry-first logo reveals: primitives (square, circle, triangle) morph in sequence and resolve into the mark, with concept-driven builds like the Integral all-seeing eye whose facets fold into the symbol.

masters.name: Afternow
masters.style: Torii identity: the house mark is built from the brand's own colour petals that bloom across the frame then collapse into the icon; palette and shape language carry the story, wordmark types in last.

masters.name: Ali Nazari
masters.style: Elisa wordmark: a smile (two dots and a curve) blinks into life, then the curve extends into the handwritten script; the logo's personality is the reveal.

masters.name: tubik
masters.style: Gotikket: a character mark with blinking eyes that squashes into a card, swaps to the wordmark with letters sliding in and returns to the icon; clean squash-and-stretch timing, one colour pair.

masters.name: Alex Gorbunov
masters.style: Notion concept: a notebook card is assembled from the product's own block types (headings, checkboxes, tags) as rounded tiles that cluster, then fold into the N mark; the mark made of what the product does.

masters.name: Evan Place
masters.style: OpenAI concept: eight orbiting dots draw together and collapse to a point, then the knot mark blooms from it; physics-like attraction easing, mark built from its own petals.

masters.name: Kxjou.motion
masters.style: Brand-concept logo animations (Logitech, Duolingo, Discord): product forms morph into the mark, e.g. mouse to webcam to keycaps resolving into the logo, with crisp 2D motion.

masters.name: Kim Holm
masters.style: Norwegian Design Council ident: folded paper strips tunnel through nested triangles and settle into the mark; tactile materials, camera moves tied to the logo's geometry.

rejected.name: ImpactFrames
rejected.why: same output farm as TimeFrame, weaker pink-gradient template look

rejected.name: Outcrowd
rejected.why: UI showcase boards that merely animate

rejected.name: Lepisov Branding
rejected.why: glossy generic logo reveals, same fade-in-with-shine on every brand

rejected.name: Maks Fede
rejected.why: NOBL sting is glitch and flash cuts, no construction idea

rejected.name: Butcher.studio
rejected.why: brand film with a photo and motion blur, logo not the subject

rejected.name: Dima Grubin
rejected.why: Pause Festival: paper shards, the logo never legibly forms

rejected.name: Mihai Dolganiuc
rejected.why: Behance-style multi-logo showcase board, nothing built

rejected.name: Daniel Bodea / Kreatank
rejected.why: Okara pixel-dot reveal, competent but template-like

rejected.name: VADYM REUTSKYI
rejected.why: Food Art: cute but basic slide-in wordmark
